foamTapeShadow.rule: Shadow is clipped to the receiver behind the piece and never baked into canonical RGB.

pieces.label: Full-card backing datum

sourceRegion.owns: immutable full canonical underlay and registration datum

pieces.donorRestoration: None; this unchanged canonical donor card is the hidden-area source for every lifted piece.
pieces.cutBoundary: No contour cut; full rectangular datum.

pieces.label: Far left pink grove

sourceRegion.owns: left pink trunks, pale canopy and atmospheric gaps inside the art field

pieces.donorRestoration: Bleed 8 px of the backing datum beneath the green-grove and ground-flora overlap; do not synthesize visible pixels.
pieces.cutBoundary: Follow pink/white canopy silhouette and vertical trunk value edges; stop beneath print bars.

pieces.label: Far center green grove

sourceRegion.owns: central green trunks, teal recess and high teal canopy

pieces.donorRestoration: Use matching donor-card center forest under Sawsbuck and crown, with 10 px hidden bleed around those contacts.
pieces.cutBoundary: Follow green trunk silhouettes and teal/pink value seams; retain negative apertures between trunks.

pieces.label: Warm right midground forest

sourceRegion.owns: orange/red trunks, warm canopy and right-side forest wall behind the animal

pieces.donorRestoration: Continue donor-card warm grove beneath crown, muzzle/chest and right foreground flora with 10 px hidden bleed.
pieces.cutBoundary: Follow warm/cool forest seam and trunk contours; crown overlap remains owned by antler-crown.

pieces.label: Ground and middle flora band

sourceRegion.owns: ground plane and vegetation behind legs, excluding near-right flora and print bars

pieces.donorRestoration: Use overlapping donor-card copies to carry continuous flowers and ground beneath all four hooves; hidden continuation must cover the approved tilt envelope.
pieces.cutBoundary: Follow upper grass/flower skyline and visible gaps around legs; print bars are excluded.

pieces.label: Rear anatomy: tail, rump, belly and hind legs

sourceRegion.owns: tail, rear torso, belly underside, both hind-leg silhouettes and rear hoof tips

pieces.donorRestoration: A second donor-card body copy supplies at least 8 px beneath the forward-shoulder overlap; ground donor content restores behind hind legs.
pieces.cutBoundary: Split anatomy on printed shoulder/torso value seam; follow tail, rump, belly, hind legs and hoof contours exactly.

pieces.label: Antler branches and autumn foliage crown

sourceRegion.owns: both antler stalks, every terminal tip, red/orange crown lobes and dangling leaf clusters

pieces.donorRestoration: Warm- and cool-forest donor cards overlap 12 px beneath crown lobes; a body donor restores hidden antler bases behind ears/head.
pieces.cutBoundary: Follow every crown lobe and dangling leaf; preserve narrow antler stalks as one registered piece with local bridges only in hidden overlap zones.

pieces.label: Forward anatomy: head, neck, chest and front legs

sourceRegion.owns: ears, face, muzzle, neck, chest ruff, shoulder and both front legs/hooves

pieces.donorRestoration: Body-rear donor overlaps 8 px under shoulder and chest; forest/ground donors restore behind head, neck and front-leg apertures.
pieces.cutBoundary: Follow face, ears, chest ruff, forelegs and hooves; anatomy split sits on the visible shoulder/torso seam, never through the eye or muzzle.

pieces.label: Nearest right and bottom flora

sourceRegion.owns: right red/orange shrubs, purple flowers, yellow stalk and bottom foreground leaf tips outside print bars

pieces.donorRestoration: Ground and warm-grove donor copies overlap 10 px under the near-flora silhouette; no fill crosses visible print bars.
pieces.cutBoundary: Follow individual flower, leaf and stalk silhouettes; split at print-bar occlusion rather than bridging across text/UI.

pieces.label: Printing and identity frame

sourceRegion.owns: outer border, name/HP/header, ability and attack typography, symbols, rules bars, illustrator/collector/footer identity

pieces.donorRestoration: None; identity pixels remain canonical and unmodified. The full backing datum closes any hidden region below this frame.
pieces.cutBoundary: Identity-locked bands and border only; do not slice through glyphs, symbols, collector number or legal footer.

completenessGates.inventory: piece IDs unique; depth ranks contiguous 0..9; every piece has sourceRegion, relationships, completeness, destination and zMm
completenessGates.partition: generated visible masks must cover each canonical art pixel exactly once except the full backing datum, which is excluded from visible-mask summation
completenessGates.extremities: every requiredExtremityGroup must have a named anchor set, nonzero alpha, at least 2 px mask margin, and a contour component surviving opening radius 1
completenessGates.edgeSafety: no non-frame piece may touch the canonical image border; every inspected contour must have an edge-overlay QA crop
completenessGates.graph: acyclic; every edge points from lower to higher depthRank; every non-backing piece reaches the identity frame or viewer
completenessGates.recomposition: neutral front composite max RGBA channel difference equals 0
completenessGates.partsSheet: exactly one separately inspectable silhouette per piece ID, no overlaps, labels visible, backing datum explicitly marked as uncut
completenessGates.failureMode: abort generation and withhold Parts Sheet/assembly authorization on any missing anchor, truncated extremity, duplicate piece, uncovered pixel or graph violation
